title: Retail Installment Contracts Payment Channel Fee Schedule
content:
Schedule of the company's charges and limits for the ways a borrower may pay a contract under Retail Installment Contracts.

## Channel fees and the debit-card limit

| Tier | Self-service payment or autopay fee (USD) | Payment taken by a live representative, fee (USD) | Largest single debit-card payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 0.00 | 9.95 | 1500.00 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 0.00 | 9.95 | 1500.00 |
| Tier 4 Standard | 0.00 | 7.95 | 2000.00 |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 0.00 | 7.95 | 2000.00 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 0.00 | 4.95 | 2500.00 |
| Tier 1 Select | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3000.00 |

Notes to the schedule:

1. The self-service fee applies to a payment made through the automated phone line, website or mobile app, by bank draft or by debit card, and to autopay.
2. The agent-assisted payment fee applies to a one-time payment taken by a live representative, by bank draft or by debit card.
3. **States where the agent-assisted fee is never charged** (every tier): CA, DC, MA, ME, NY.

## Channels accepted on certified-funds-only status (every tier)

While a contract is on certified-funds-only status, only these channels are accepted:

- debit card through a live representative;
- debit card through the phone line, website or app;
- MoneyGram;
- wire transfer;
- certified funds (cashier's check or money order).

Every bank-draft channel, autopay included, and mailed personal checks are refused while the status lasts.

**Hypothetical readings.** A Tier 4 Standard borrower in Ohio who pays by debit card through a representative falls under the 7.95 agent-assisted fee on this schedule, and a 2400.00 payment is above the Tier 4 Standard card limit of 2000.00. The same payment by a Tier 1 Select borrower is within the 3000.00 limit, and that tier's agent-assisted fee is 0.00.
